# Drawer

Drawer that slides in from the right, for viewing details or editing longer content without leaving the
current page.

**Interaction**: when it opens, focus moves into the drawer and `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` cycle inside it; `Esc`
closes it, and focus returns to the element that was focused before opening.

**Category**: Feedback · **Common uses**: Details and editing that keep the context of a list, such as member details, permission settings or conversation settings

## Import

```ts
import { Drawer } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Slides in from the right to show details while keeping the context of the list.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  return (
    <>
      <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>View member</Button>
      <Drawer title="Alex Morgan" open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} size={480}>
        <Section title="Details">
          <Descriptions
            column={1}
            items={[
              { key: 'team', label: 'Team', children: 'Design' },
              { key: 'role', label: 'Role', children: 'Editor' },
            ]}
          />
        </Section>
      </Drawer>
    </>
  )
}
```

## Props

No props of its own.

Also accepts the props of the corresponding Ant Design component (`DrawerProps`), except `style` and `className`.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
